title: Grounded Well-Condition Anomaly Detection on the Volve Field: Constructed Labels, a Baseline, and a Dual-Head Model
abstract: arXiv:2608.05685v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Most public benchmarks for machine-condition monitoring come from test rigs, where faults are induced on purpose and every event is known. Real production fields rarely offer that. They give you sensor histories with no fault log attached, which is exactly the situation where an anomaly-detection method has to invent its own labels, and where quiet assumptions can slip in unnoticed. We work with the open Volve field data released by Equinor and take two things seriously that such datasets usually skip. First, we build anomaly labels that are not just patterns in the numbers but are checked against what the field's own engineering documents say can physically go wrong, and we release the reasoning behind every label. translated_title: 基于Volve油田的接地良好条件异常检测：构建标签、基线模型与双头模型
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.05685v2 公告类型：替换 摘要：大多数用于机器状态监测的公开基准测试来自试验台，其中故障是有意诱导的，且每个事件都是已知的。真实的生产油田很少提供这种情况。它们只提供传感器历史数据，而没有故障日志，这正是异常检测方法必须自行创造标签的情况，也是可能悄然引入未注意假设的场合。我们使用Equinor发布的开放Volve油田数据，并认真对待此类数据集通常忽略的两个方面。首先，我们构建异常标签，这些标签不仅仅是数字中的模式，而是对照油田自身的工程文档中所述可能物理出错的内容进行验证，并公开每个标签背后的推理。其次，我们测试这些构建的标签是否可学习，使用无监督基线和一个小型双头模型，该模型标记事件发生的时间及其类型，这一想法源自我们早期的工作。
tldr: 本文在真实油田数据上构建了基于工程文档验证的异常标签，并测试了双头模型能否同时识别事件发生时间和类型，填补了实际工业场景中无故障日志的异常检测空白。
en_tdlr: This paper constructs engineering-validated anomaly labels on real field data and tests whether a dual-head model can simultaneously identify event timing and type, addressing the gap of anomaly detection without fault logs in real industrial settings.
